title_quote: The smart speaker box just arrived!

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The smart speaker box just arrived!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɑrt ˈspiːkər bɑks dʒʌst əˈraɪvd!/
dialogue.zh: 智慧音箱的包裹剛到！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's open it on the kitchen table.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts ˈoʊpən ɪt ɑn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈteɪbəl!/
dialogue.zh: 我們在廚房桌上拆開吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What is inside the box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪz ɪnˈsaɪd ðə bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 盒子裡面有什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A speaker, a cord, and a small guide.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈspiːkər, ə kɔrd, ænd ə smɔl ɡaɪd!/
dialogue.zh: 一個音箱、一條線，還有一本小指南。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This guide looks really short.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɡaɪd lʊks ˈrɪəli ʃɔrt!/
dialogue.zh: 這本指南看起來真短。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Setup usually takes about ten minutes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛtˌʌp ˈuʒuəli teɪks əˈbaʊt tɛn ˈmɪnɪts!/
dialogue.zh: 設置通常只要十分鐘左右。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should we put the speaker?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd wi pʊt ðə ˈspiːkər?/
dialogue.zh: 音箱該放在哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The living room shelf sounds perfect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum ʃɛlf saʊndz ˈpɜrfɪkt!/
dialogue.zh: 放客廳的架子上剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can you pass me the power cord?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ju pæs mi ðə ˈpaʊər kɔrd?/
dialogue.zh: 把電源線遞給我好嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Here you go, be careful with it.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ju ɡoʊ, bi ˈkɛrfəl wɪð ɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 給你，小心一點拿。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plug fits the wall socket.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plʌɡ fɪts ðə wɔl ˈsɑkɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 插頭剛好能插進牆上的插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now press the button on the back.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ prɛs ðə ˈbʌtən ɑn ðə bæk!/
dialogue.zh: 現在按一下背後的按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A blue light just turned on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə blu laɪt dʒʌst tɜrnd ɑn!/
dialogue.zh: 一盞藍燈剛剛亮起來了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it has power now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt hæz ˈpaʊər naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 那就代表它通電了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you buy the smart bulbs too?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju baɪ ðə smɑrt bʌlbz tu?/
dialogue.zh: 你有買智能燈泡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, a pack of four is right here.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ə pæk ʌv fɔr ɪz raɪt hɪr!/
dialogue.zh: 有啊，四入裝就在這裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which room needs new bulbs first?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ rum nidz nju bʌlbz fɜrst?/
dialogue.zh: 哪個房間先換燈泡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's start with the bedroom lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts stɑrt wɪð ðə ˈbɛdˌrum læmp!/
dialogue.zh: 先從臥室的台燈開始吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we turn off the old switch?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi tɜrn ɔf ði oʊld swɪtʃ?/
dialogue.zh: 要先把舊開關關掉嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, always cut the power first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈɔlweɪz kʌt ðə ˈpaʊər fɜrst!/
dialogue.zh: 要，務必先斷電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This old bulb is still warm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs oʊld bʌlb ɪz stɪl wɔrm!/
dialogue.zh: 這個舊燈泡還熱熱的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait a minute, then unscrew it slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ə ˈmɪnɪt, ðɛn ʌnˈskru ɪt ˈsloʊli!/
dialogue.zh: 等一下，再慢慢把它轉下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The new bulb screws in easily.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə nju bʌlb skrus ɪn ˈizəli!/
dialogue.zh: 新燈泡很容易就轉進去了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, you can switch the power back on.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ju kæn swɪtʃ ðə ˈpaʊər bæk ɑn!/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，你可以把電打開了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It lights up with a soft glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt laɪts ʌp wɪð ə sɔft ɡloʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 它亮起來，光是柔和的。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: I love that warm white color.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ðæt wɔrm waɪt ˈkʌlər!/
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡那種暖白色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How is this bulb different?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ ɪz ðɪs bʌlb ˈdɪfərənt?/
dialogue.zh: 這個燈泡有什麼不一樣？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can control it with your phone.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn kənˈtroʊl ɪt wɪð jɔr foʊn!/
dialogue.zh: 你可以用手機控制它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it change colors at night?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ɪt tʃeɪndʒ ˈkʌlərz æt naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 它晚上能變換顏色嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, pick any color you like.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, pɪk ˈɛni ˈkʌlər ju laɪk!/
dialogue.zh: 當然，你喜歡什麼顏色都行。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Put the second bulb in the hallway.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊt ðə ˈsɛkənd bʌlb ɪn ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ!/
dialogue.zh: 第二個燈泡裝到走廊去。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good idea, that hall is too dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd aɪˈdiə, ðæt hɔl ɪz tu dɑrk!/
dialogue.zh: 好主意，那條走廊太暗了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do these bulbs fit every lamp?
dialogue.phonetic: /du ðiz bʌlbz fɪt ˈɛvri læmp?/
dialogue.zh: 這些燈泡每盞燈都能裝嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Most lamps, but check the size first.
dialogue.phonetic: /moʊst læmpz, bʌt tʃɛk ðə saɪz fɜrst!/
dialogue.zh: 大多數可以，但要先看尺寸。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This box says it lasts five years.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs bɑks sɛz ɪt læsts faɪv jɪrz!/
dialogue.zh: 盒子上寫能用五年。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That beats buying new bulbs every year.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt bits ˈbaɪɪŋ nju bʌlbz ˈɛvri jɪr!/
dialogue.zh: 那總比年年買新燈泡好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Listen, the speaker is making a sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlɪsən, ðə ˈspiːkər ɪz ˈmeɪkɪŋ ə saʊnd!/
dialogue.zh: 聽，音箱發出聲音了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says it is ready to connect.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ɪt ɪz ˈrɛdi tə kəˈnɛkt!/
dialogue.zh: 它說它準備好要連線了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Connect? Connect to what exactly?
dialogue.phonetic: /kəˈnɛkt? kəˈnɛkt tə wʌt ɪɡˈzæktli?/
dialogue.zh: 連線？連到什麼東西？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: To the wifi, using the free app.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ, ˈjuzɪŋ ðə fri æp!/
dialogue.zh: 連家裡的無線網絡，用那個免費App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is there a tiny reset button?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðɛr ə ˈtaɪni riˈsɛt ˈbʌtən?/
dialogue.zh: 有一個小小的重置鍵嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, under the cord at the bottom.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈʌndər ðə kɔrd æt ðə ˈbɑtəm!/
dialogue.zh: 有，在底部、電線的下面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hey, the ring light keeps blinking orange.
dialogue.phonetic: /heɪ, ðə rɪŋ laɪt kips ˈblɪŋkɪŋ ˈɔrɪndʒ!/
dialogue.zh: 嘿，那圈燈一直閃橘色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Orange means it waits for setup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔrɪndʒ minz ɪt weɪts fər ˈsɛtˌʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 橘色代表它在等設置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you keep the receipt?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju kip ðə riˈsit?/
dialogue.zh: 你有保留收據嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it covers a two-year warranty.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ɪt ˈkʌvərz ə tu jɪr ˈwɔrənti!/
dialogue.zh: 當然，保固兩年。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we do with this empty box?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ʃʊd wi du wɪð ði ˈɛmti bɑks?/
dialogue.zh: 這個空盒子怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Fold it flat and keep it for now.
dialogue.phonetic: /foʊld ɪt flæt ænd kip ɪt fər naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 壓扁收好，先留著。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why keep the box so long?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ kip ðə bɑks soʊ lɔŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼要留這麼久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You may return it if something breaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju meɪ rɪˈtɜrn ɪt ɪf ˈsʌmθɪŋ breɪks!/
dialogue.zh: 萬一壞掉可以退貨。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This speaker feels heavy and solid.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈspiːkər filz ˈhɛvi ænd ˈsɑlɪd!/
dialogue.zh: 這音箱摸起來又重又紮實。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Weight usually means a better sound.
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt ˈuʒuəli minz ə ˈbɛtər saʊnd!/
dialogue.zh: 有重量通常代表音質比較好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Are the bulbs brighter than the old ones?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑr ðə bʌlbz ˈbraɪtər ðæn ði oʊld wʌnz?/
dialogue.zh: 新燈泡比舊的亮嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but they use less electricity.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt ðeɪ juz lɛs ɪˌlɛkˈtrɪsəti!/
dialogue.zh: 亮，但更省電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Please read that warning sticker aloud.
dialogue.phonetic: /pliz rid ðæt ˈwɔrnɪŋ ˈstɪkər əˈlaʊd!/
dialogue.zh: 請把那張警告貼紙念出來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says: keep the speaker away from water.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz: kip ðə ˈspiːkər əˈweɪ frʌm ˈwɔtər!/
dialogue.zh: 它寫：音箱要遠離水。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good point, the shelf is near the window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd pɔɪnt, ðə ʃɛlf ɪz nɪr ðə ˈwɪndoʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 說得好，架子就在窗邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's move it to the other side.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts muv ɪt tə ði ˈʌðər saɪd!/
dialogue.zh: 我們把它搬到另一邊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now the cord hides behind the desk.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə kɔrd haɪdz bɪˈhaɪnd ðə dɛsk!/
dialogue.zh: 現在線藏在桌子後面了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Much cleaner, nothing dangles down.
dialogue.phonetic: /mʌtʃ ˈklinər, ˈnʌθɪŋ ˈdæŋɡəlz daʊn!/
dialogue.zh: 乾淨多了，沒有線垂下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does this bulb work outside?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðɪs bʌlb wɜrk ˌaʊtˈsaɪd?/
dialogue.zh: 這燈泡能在室外用嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, this pack is for indoor lamps only.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ðɪs pæk ɪz fər ˈɪnˌdɔr læmpz ˈoʊnli!/
dialogue.zh: 不行，這組只能用在室內。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Too bad, the porch light is broken.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu bæd, ðə pɔrtʃ laɪt ɪz ˈbroʊkən!/
dialogue.zh: 真可惜，門廊燈壞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: We can buy outdoor bulbs next month.
dialogue.phonetic: /wi kæn baɪ ˈaʊtˌdɔr bʌlbz nɛkst mʌnθ!/
dialogue.zh: 下個月再買室外的好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This guide shows pictures, no long words.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ɡaɪd ʃoʊz ˈpɪktʃərz, noʊ lɔŋ wɜrdz!/
dialogue.zh: 這本指南全是圖，沒有長字。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect for people who hate manuals.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt fər ˈpipəl hu heɪt ˈmænjuəlz!/
dialogue.zh: 最適合討厭說明書的人了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I hate manuals, but not this one.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ heɪt ˈmænjuəlz, bʌt nɑt ðɪs wʌn!/
dialogue.zh: 我討厭說明書，但這本還好。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, see? Even setup can be relaxing.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ, si? ˈivən ˈsɛtˌʌp kæn bi rɪˈlæksɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 哈，看吧？連設置都能很放鬆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Well, the old wall switch still works.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl, ðə oʊld wɔl swɪtʃ stɪl wɜrks!/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，牆上的舊開關還是能用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Right, the smart bulb keeps old habits.
dialogue.phonetic: /raɪt, ðə smɑrt bʌlb kips oʊld ˈhæbɪts!/
dialogue.zh: 對，智能燈泡保留舊用法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What if someone flips the switch off?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ɪf ˈsʌmwʌn flɪps ðə swɪtʃ ɔf?/
dialogue.zh: 如果有人把開關關了怎麼辦？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then the bulb sleeps until power returns.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə bʌlb slips ʌnˈtɪl ˈpaʊər rɪˈtɜrnz!/
dialogue.zh: 那燈泡就睡著，等來電再醒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That button on top does what?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ˈbʌtən ɑn tɑp dʌz wʌt?/
dialogue.zh: 頂上那個按鈕是做什麼的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One press and it stops talking.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn prɛs ænd ɪt stɑps ˈtɔkɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 按一下，它就停止說話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can two people lift this shelf?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn tu ˈpipəl lɪft ðɪs ʃɛlf?/
dialogue.zh: 兩個人能抬起這個架子嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tilt it up toward the wall.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tɪlt ɪt ʌp təˈwɔrd ðə wɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把它斜靠向牆。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The speaker sits there like a pet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspiːkər sɪts ðɛr laɪk ə pɛt!/
dialogue.zh: 音箱坐在那兒像只小寵物。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Don't name it yet, that comes later.
dialogue.phonetic: /doʊnt neɪm ɪt jɛt, ðæt kʌmz ˈleɪtər!/
dialogue.zh: 先別幫它取名，那還在後面。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Later? We still have more to do?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈleɪtər? wi stɪl hæv mɔr tə du?/
dialogue.zh: 後面還有事做嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plenty: apps, names, rooms, routines.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈplɛnti: æps, neɪmz, rumz, ruˈtins!/
dialogue.zh: 多著呢：App、命名、房間、自動化。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My fingers are tired of tiny screws.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈfɪŋɡərz ɑr ˈtaɪərd ʌv ˈtaɪni skruz!/
dialogue.zh: 我的手指轉小螺絲轉累了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Take a break, I will finish the lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /teɪk ə breɪk, aɪ wɪl ˈfɪnɪʃ ðə læmp!/
dialogue.zh: 你休息，台燈我來裝。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the hallway bulb go in tight?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ bʌlb ɡoʊ ɪn taɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 走廊的燈泡鎖緊了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Snug and safe, no wobble at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /snʌɡ ænd seɪf, noʊ ˈwɑbəl æt ɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 又緊又穩，一點都不搖。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Both new lights work at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /boʊθ nju laɪts wɜrk æt wʌns!/
dialogue.zh: 兩盞新燈一次就亮了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Installation day feels like a small win.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnstəˈleɪʃən deɪ filz laɪk ə smɔl wɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 安裝日就像一場小勝利。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do smart bulbs ever get hot?
dialogue.phonetic: /du smɑrt bʌlbz ˈɛvər ɡɛt hɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 智能燈泡會發燙嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Barely, they stay cool to the touch.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛrli, ðeɪ steɪ kul tə ðə tʌtʃ!/
dialogue.zh: 幾乎不會，摸起來涼涼的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That surprises me a little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt sərˈpraɪzəz mi ə ˈlɪtəl!/
dialogue.zh: 這點讓我有點驚訝。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Old bulbs were real little heaters.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊld bʌlbz wɜr riəl ˈlɪtəl ˈhitərz!/
dialogue.zh: 舊燈泡根本是小暖爐。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hmm, the guide mentions one more step.
dialogue.phonetic: /hʌm, ðə ɡaɪd ˈmɛnʃənz wʌn mɔr stɛp!/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，指南還提到一個步驟。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Of course, it wants the matching app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌv kɔrs, ɪt wɑnts ðə ˈmætʃɪŋ æp!/
dialogue.zh: 當然，它要那個配套的App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is that app free to install?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ðæt æp fri tə ɪnˈstɔl?/
dialogue.zh: 那個App是免費的嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, no card, no fees at all.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, noʊ kɑrd, noʊ fiz æt ɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 免費，不用綁卡也不收費。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Search the store for the brand name.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɜrtʃ ðə stɔr fər ðə brænd neɪm!/
dialogue.zh: 在商店裡搜這個牌子名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Found it, the icon is a tiny house.
dialogue.phonetic: /faʊnd ɪt, ði ˈaɪkɑn ɪz ə ˈtaɪni haʊs!/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，圖標的形狀是小房子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Installing now, this only takes seconds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌɪnstəˈleɪtɪŋ naʊ, ðɪs ˈoʊnli teɪks ˈsɛkəndz!/
dialogue.zh: 正在安裝，只要幾秒鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Open it once the bar fills up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊpən ɪt wʌns ðə bɑr fɪlz ʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 進度條跑完就打開它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It greets us with big round letters.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɡriːts ʌs wɪð bɪɡ raʊnd ˈlɛtərz!/
dialogue.zh: 它用好大好圓的字跟我們打招呼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step one: create an account.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp wʌn: kriˈeɪt ən əˈkaʊnt!/
dialogue.zh: 第一步：建立一個帳號。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we use email or phone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi juz ˈimel ɔr foʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 要用電子郵件還是電話註冊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Email is safer for a shared home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈimel ɪz ˈseɪfər fər ə ʃɛrd hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 共用家庭帳號的話，電子郵件比較安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Type the password twice, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ðə ˈpæswɜrd twaɪs, ˈsloʊli!/
dialogue.zh: 密碼慢慢輸入兩次。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, the app says welcome home.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ði æp sɛz ˈwɛlkəm hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 好了，App說歡迎回家。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for our house name.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt æsks fər ˈaʊər haʊs neɪm!/
dialogue.zh: 現在它要我們給房子取名。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's call it the cozy castle.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts kɔl ɪt ðə ˈkoʊzi ˈkæsəl!/
dialogue.zh: 就叫它溫馨城堡吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Here it starts to look for devices.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ɪt stɑrts tə lʊk fər dɪˈvaɪsəz!/
dialogue.zh: 它開始搜尋裝置了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap search and keep the speaker close.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp sɜrtʃ ænd kip ðə ˈspiːkər kloʊs!/
dialogue.zh: 點搜尋，並把音箱拿近一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did it find the speaker already?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ɪt faɪnd ðə ˈspiːkər ɔlˈrɛdi?/
dialogue.zh: 它已經找到音箱了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, one device on the screen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wʌn dɪˈvaɪs ɑn ðə skrin!/
dialogue.zh: 找到了，螢幕上有一個裝置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It says pairing in progress.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz ˈpɛrɪŋ ɪn ˈprɑɡrɛs!/
dialogue.zh: 上面寫著正在配對中。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Do not touch anything yet.
dialogue.phonetic: /du nɑt tʌtʃ ˈɛniθɪŋ jɛt!/
dialogue.zh: 先別碰任何東西。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why is the circle still spinning?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ ɪz ðə ˈsɜrkəl stɪl ˈspɪnɪŋ?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼圈圈還在轉？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pairing can take a full minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɛrɪŋ kæn teɪk ə fʊl ˈmɪnɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 配對可能要花整整一分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we move the phone closer?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi muv ðə foʊn ˈkloʊsər?/
dialogue.zh: 要把手機拿近一點嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, Bluetooth likes a short distance.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈblutʊθ laɪks ə ʃɔrt ˈdɪstəns!/
dialogue.zh: 要，藍牙喜歡近距離。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now it asks for the wifi password.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ɪt æsks fər ðə ˈwaɪfaɪ ˈpæswɜrd!/
dialogue.zh: 現在它問無線網絡密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It is on the router, in small print.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ɪz ɑn ðə ˈraʊtər, ɪn smɔl prɪnt!/
dialogue.zh: 寫在路由器上，字超小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Which password? There are two here.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪtʃ ˈpæswɜrd? ðɛr ɑr tu hɪr!/
dialogue.zh: 哪個密碼？這裡有兩個。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Use the home one, not the guest network.
dialogue.phonetic: /juz ði hoʊm wʌn, nɑt ðə ɡɛst ˈnɛtˌwɜrk!/
dialogue.zh: 家用那個，不要用訪客網絡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Typed it in, fingers crossed.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪpt ɪt ɪn, ˈfɪŋɡərz krɔst!/
dialogue.zh: 輸入了，希望一次成功。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The speaker says: you are connected.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspiːkər sɛz: ju ɑr kəˈnɛktɪd!/
dialogue.zh: 音箱說：你已經連上了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yay, that voice sounds friendly.
dialogue.phonetic: /jeɪ, ðæt vɔɪs saʊndz ˈfrɛndli!/
dialogue.zh: 耶，那個聲音好友善。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now let's name the speaker itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛts neɪm ðə ˈspiːkər ɪtˈsɛlf!/
dialogue.zh: 接下來幫音箱取名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we name it Captain Home?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi neɪm ɪt ˈkæptən hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 可以叫它管家先生嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, type Captain Home in the box.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, taɪp ˈkæptən hoʊm ɪn ðə bɑks!/
dialogue.zh: 好啊，在欄位輸入管家先生。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the bulbs? Do they need names?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt əˈbaʊt ðə bʌlbz? du ðeɪ nid neɪmz?/
dialogue.zh: 燈泡呢？它們也要名字嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, names make voice commands simple.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, neɪmz meɪk vɔɪs kəˈmændz ˈsɪmpəl!/
dialogue.zh: 要，有了名字語音指令才簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Call the bedroom lamp Moon Light.
dialogue.phonetic: /kɔl ðə ˈbɛdˌrum læmp mun laɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 臥室的台燈就叫月亮燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lovely name, saved in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈlʌvli neɪm, seɪvd ɪn ði æp!/
dialogue.zh: 名字真美，已存進App。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And the hallway bulb?
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ bʌlb?/
dialogue.zh: 那走廊的燈泡呢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name it Star, since it is so small.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ɪt stɑr, sɪns ɪt ɪz soʊ smɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 叫它小星星，因為它小小的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can one word name two devices?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wʌn wɜrd neɪm tu dɪˈvaɪsəz?/
dialogue.zh: 一個名字可以給兩個裝置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: No, every device needs a unique name.
dialogue.phonetic: /noʊ, ˈɛvri dɪˈvaɪs nidz ə juˈnik neɪm!/
dialogue.zh: 不行，每個裝置都要獨一無二的名字。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next, it asks us to pick rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst, ɪt æsks ʌs tə pɪk rumz!/
dialogue.zh: 接著，它要我們挑房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Create living room, bedroom, and kitchen first.
dialogue.phonetic: /kriˈeɪt ˈlɪvɪŋ rum, ˈbɛdˌrum, ænd ˈkɪtʃɪn fɜrst!/
dialogue.zh: 先建客廳、臥室和廚房。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should the office be its own room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd ði ˈɔfɪs bi ɪts oʊn rum?/
dialogue.zh: 書房要單獨算一個房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, then you can say: office lights on.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ðɛn ju kæn seɪ: ˈɔfɪs laɪts ɑn!/
dialogue.zh: 要，這樣就能說：開書房的燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What about the balcony, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt əˈbaʊt ðə ˈbælkəni, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那陽台要算一個房間嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Not yet, one small light does not need it.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɑt jɛt, wʌn smɔl laɪt dʌz nɑt nid ɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 暫時不用，一盞小燈還不需要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Drag the lamp into the bedroom list.
dialogue.phonetic: /dræɡ ðə læmp ˈɪntu ðə ˈbɛdˌrum lɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 把台燈拖進臥室的清單裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, it shows a tiny bed icon.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ɪt ʃoʊz ə ˈtaɪni bɛd ˈaɪkɑn!/
dialogue.zh: 好了，它出現一個小床圖標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It even wants our whole floor plan.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈivən wɑnts ˈaʊər hoʊl flɔr plæn!/
dialogue.zh: 它甚至想要我們家的完整格局。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just tap the rooms that exist at home.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst tæp ðə rumz ðɑt ɪɡˈzɪst æt hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 點選家裡有的房間就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you add my phone to our home?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju æd maɪ foʊn tə ˈaʊər hoʊm?/
dialogue.zh: 你有把我的手機加入家裡嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, open the invite and accept it.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈoʊpən ði ɪnˈvaɪt ænd əkˈsɛpt ɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 有，打開邀請接受就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now I can turn on the lights too?
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ aɪ kæn tɜrn ɑn ðə laɪts tu?/
dialogue.zh: 所以我也能開燈了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try the big round button in the middle.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ðə bɪɡ raʊnd ˈbʌtən ɪn ðə ˈmɪdəl!/
dialogue.zh: 試試中間那顆圓圓的大按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bedroom light just answered me!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɛdˌrum laɪt dʒʌst ˈænsərd mi!/
dialogue.zh: 臥室的燈剛剛回應我了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the magic of a smart home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə ˈmædʒɪk ʌv ə smɑrt hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 這就是智能家居的魔法。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we dim it with this slider?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi dɪm ɪt wɪð ðɪs ˈslaɪdər?/
dialogue.zh: 可以用這個滑塊調暗嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Slide left for soft, slide right for bright.
dialogue.phonetic: /slaɪd lɛft fər sɔft, slaɪd raɪt fər braɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 往左變柔和，往右變明亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Look, the color wheel has dozens of shades.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk, ðə ˈkʌlər wil hæz ˈdʌzəns ʌv ʃeɪdz!/
dialogue.zh: 你看，色輪上有幾十種顏色。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Pick a calm blue for rainy nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /pɪk ə kɑm blu fər ˈreɪni naɪts!/
dialogue.zh: 下雨天選個安靜的藍色吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This warm orange feels like sunset.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs wɔrm ˈɔrɪndʒ filz laɪk ˈsʌnˌsɛt!/
dialogue.zh: 這個暖橘色感覺像日落。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Save it as a favorite color scene.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪv ɪt æz ə ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʌlər sin!/
dialogue.zh: 把它存成最愛的顏色場景。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the app remember my brightness?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ði æp rɪˈmɛmbər maɪ ˈbraɪtnəs?/
dialogue.zh: App會記得我的亮度嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, each device keeps its last setting.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, itʃ dɪˈvaɪs kips ɪts læst ˈsɛtɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 會，每個裝置都記得最後一次的設置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How do I add the second speaker?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ du aɪ æd ðə ˈsɛkənd ˈspiːkər?/
dialogue.zh: 第二台音箱怎麼加進來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tap plus, then follow the same steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /tæp plʌs, ðɛn ˈfɑloʊ ðə seɪm stɛps!/
dialogue.zh: 點加號，步驟跟剛才一樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where should the kitchen speaker live?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr ʃʊd ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn ˈspiːkər lɪv?/
dialogue.zh: 廚房的音箱放哪裡好？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: High on the shelf, away from the stove.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ ɑn ðə ʃɛlf, əˈweɪ frʌm ðə stoʊv!/
dialogue.zh: 放高一點，遠離爐子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name this one Chef, does that work?
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ðɪs wʌn ʃɛf, dʌz ðæt wɜrk?/
dialogue.zh: 這台叫大廚，可以嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, Captain and Chef make a team.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ˈkæptən ænd ʃɛf meɪk ə tim!/
dialogue.zh: 完美，管家和大廚搭檔了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Interesting, it drew my home like a map.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɪntrəstɪŋ, ɪt dru maɪ hoʊm laɪk ə mæp!/
dialogue.zh: 有趣，它把我家畫得像張地圖。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Move the icons to match the real rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /muv ði ˈaɪkɑnz tə mætʃ ðə ril rumz!/
dialogue.zh: 把圖標拖到實際房間的位置。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why does the lamp show a gray dot?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dʌz ðə læmp ʃoʊ ə ɡreɪ dɑt?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼台燈顯示灰點？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Gray means offline, check its power.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪ minz ˌɔfˈlaɪn, tʃɛk ɪts ˈpaʊər!/
dialogue.zh: 灰色代表離線，檢查有沒有通電。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, I forgot to switch the lamp on.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, aɪ fərˈɡɑt tə swɪtʃ ðə læmp ɑn!/
dialogue.zh: 噢，我忘了打開台燈開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the dot turned green, all set.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə dɑt tɜrnd ɡrin, ɔl sɛt!/
dialogue.zh: 現在圓點變綠了，沒問題了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we group several bulbs together?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi ɡrup ˈsɛvərəl bʌlbz təˈɡɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 可以把幾個燈泡分組嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, make a ceiling group for the living room.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, meɪk ə ˈsilɪŋ ɡrup fər ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，幫客廳做個吸頂燈群組。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then one command lights the whole room?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn wʌn kəˈmænd laɪts ðə hoʊl rum?/
dialogue.zh: 那一條指令就能點亮整個房間？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the group moves as one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli, ðə ɡrup muvz æz wʌn!/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，群組會一起動作。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Also, it offers a daily news briefing.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɔlsoʊ, ɪt ˈɔfərz ə ˈdeɪli nuz ˈbriˌfɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 它還提供每天的新聞簡報。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Let's allow it, morning reports sound nice.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts əˈlaʊ ɪt, ˈmɔrnɪŋ rɪˈpɔrts saʊnd naɪs!/
dialogue.zh: 同意吧，早上的報告聽起來不錯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Allow location? Why does it need that?
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlaʊ loʊˈkeɪʃən? waɪ dʌz ɪt nid ðæt?/
dialogue.zh: 允許定位？它為什麼需要？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It turns on lights when you get home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɜrnz ɑn laɪts wɛn ju ɡɛt hoʊm./
dialogue.zh: 它會在你到家時把燈打開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That sounds useful on dark winter nights.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt saʊndz ˈjusfəl ɑn dɑrk ˈwɪntər naɪts!/
dialogue.zh: 漆黑的冬夜應該很好用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then enable it just for our home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪˈneɪbəl ɪt dʒʌst fər ˈaʊər hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 那就只為我們家開啟它。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Almost done: a wake word test.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈlmoʊst dʌn: ə weɪk wɜrd tɛst!/
dialogue.zh: 差不多了：一個喚醒詞測試。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say the wake word twice in a calm voice.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ðə weɪk wɜrd twaɪs ɪn ə kɑm vɔɪs!/
dialogue.zh: 用平靜的聲音說兩次喚醒詞。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain! Did it hear me clearly?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən! dɪd ɪt hir mi ˈklɪrli?/
dialogue.zh: 管家！它聽清楚了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ring glows blue, so yes, it did.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪŋ ɡloʊz blu, soʊ jɛs, ɪt dɪd!/
dialogue.zh: 燈圈變藍了，聽得很清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Will it hear me from the bedroom?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪl ɪt hir mi frʌm ðə ˈbɛdˌrum?/
dialogue.zh: 在臥室它也聽得到嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try it tonight with the door closed.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ ɪt təˈnaɪt wɪð ðə dɔr kloʊzd!/
dialogue.zh: 今晚關上門試試看。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Great, the app finished all the basics.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ði æp ˈfɪnɪʃt ɔl ðə ˈbeɪsɪks!/
dialogue.zh: 太好了，App的基本設置都跑完了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Six devices online, three rooms ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɪks dɪˈvaɪsəz ˌɑnˈlaɪn, θri rumz ˈrɛdi!/
dialogue.zh: 六個裝置上線，三個房間就緒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we add the smart plug today?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi æd ðə smɑrt plʌɡ təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天要把智能插座也加進來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, it controls the old floor lamp.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, ɪt kənˈtroʊlz ði oʊld flɔr læmp!/
dialogue.zh: 好，它可以控制那盞舊立燈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plug it in, then hold the tiny button.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ ɪt ɪn, ðɛn hoʊld ðə ˈtaɪni ˈbʌtən!/
dialogue.zh: 插上電，再按住小按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app found it in one second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp faʊnd ɪt ɪn wʌn ˈsɛkənd!/
dialogue.zh: App一秒就找到它了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Name the plug after the lamp it runs.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm ðə plʌɡ ˈæftər ðə læmp ɪt rʌnz!/
dialogue.zh: 用立燈的名字來命名插座。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good plan, no confusing names in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd plæn, noʊ kənˈfjuːzɪŋ neɪmz ɪn ði æp!/
dialogue.zh: 好計畫，App裡就不會搞混。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every device has a small info page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri dɪˈvaɪs hæz ə smɔl ˈɪnfə peɪdʒ!/
dialogue.zh: 每個裝置都有一張小資訊頁。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Check it for battery and signal strength.
dialogue.phonetic: /tʃɛk ɪt fər ˈbætəri ænd ˈsɪɡnəl strɛŋθ!/
dialogue.zh: 在裡面看電量和訊號強度。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See how the bedroom signal has two bars.
dialogue.phonetic: /si haʊ ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ˈsɪɡnəl hæz tu bɑrz!/
dialogue.zh: 你看，臥室訊號只剩兩格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then move the lamp nearer to the hall.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn muv ðə læmp ˈnɪrər tə ðə hɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 那把台燈往走廊移一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Better now? The page shows three bars.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛtər naʊ? ðə peɪdʒ ʃoʊz θri bɑrz!/
dialogue.zh: 現在好了嗎？頁面顯示三格。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Great, pairing is finally all done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡreɪt, ˈpɛrɪŋ ɪz ˈfaɪnəli ɔl dʌn!/
dialogue.zh: 太棒了，配對全部完成了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Time to test all these voice commands.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪm tə tɛst ɔl ðiz vɔɪs kəˈmændz!/
dialogue.zh: 該來測試語音指令了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Start with something simple and fun.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɑrt wɪð ˈsʌmθɪŋ ˈsɪmpəl ænd fʌn!/
dialogue.zh: 先從簡單有趣的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, turn on the living room lights!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, tɜrn ɑn ðə ˈlɪvɪŋ rum laɪts!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，打開客廳的燈！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It answered in less than a second.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈænsərd ɪn lɛs ðæn ə ˈsɛkənd!/
dialogue.zh: 不到一秒它就回應了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, dim the bedroom lamp to half.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, dɪm ðə ˈbɛdˌrum læmp tə hæf!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，把台燈調到一半亮度。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The light faded down so smoothly.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪt ˈfeɪdɪd daʊn soʊ ˈsmuðli!/
dialogue.zh: 燈光好順滑地暗了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can it set a color by name?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ɪt sɛt ə ˈkʌlər baɪ neɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 它能用顏色名字來設置嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Try: make the hallway light gold.
dialogue.phonetic: /traɪ: meɪk ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ laɪt ɡoʊld!/
dialogue.zh: 試試說：把走廊燈變成金色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, set the hallway to gold!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, sɛt ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ tə ɡoʊld!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，走廊燈變成金色！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Look at that warm golden glow.
dialogue.phonetic: /lʊk æt ðæt wɔrm ˈɡoʊldən ɡloʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 看那溫暖的金色光暈。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Now let's build a movie night scene.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ lɛts bɪld ə ˈmuvi naɪt sin!/
dialogue.zh: 來做一個電影之夜場景。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One phrase can do ten little tasks.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn freɪz kæn du tɛn ˈlɪtəl tæsks!/
dialogue.zh: 一句話可以完成十件小事。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This scene should lower the lights first.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs sin ʃʊd ˈloʊər ðə laɪts fɜrst!/
dialogue.zh: 這個場景要先讓燈光變暗。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then hush the house and start the film.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn hʌʃ ðə haʊs ænd stɑrt ðə fɪlm!/
dialogue.zh: 再讓屋子安靜下來，開始放片。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What should we say to start it?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt ʃʊd wi seɪ tə stɑrt ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 要說什麼才能啟動這個場景？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Just say: movie time, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʒʌst seɪ: ˈmuvi taɪm, pliz!/
dialogue.zh: 只要說：請進入電影時間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Movie time, please! Wow, it worked!
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmuvi taɪm, pliz! waʊ, ɪt wɜrkt!/
dialogue.zh: 請放電影模式！哇，成功了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole room changed in one breath.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl rum tʃeɪndʒd ɪn wʌn brɛθ!/
dialogue.zh: 整個房間一口氣換了模樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's make a reading scene for evenings.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts meɪk ə ˈridɪŋ sin fər ˈivnɪŋz!/
dialogue.zh: 再做一個晚間閱讀場景。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Bright warm light, only near the chair.
dialogue.phonetic: /braɪt wɔrm laɪt, ˈoʊnli nɪr ðə tʃɛr!/
dialogue.zh: 只照亮椅子附近的暖光。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a wake-up scene for mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə weɪk ʌp sin fər ˈmɔrnɪŋz!/
dialogue.zh: 還要一個早起的場景。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights slowly rise, then soft music plays.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts ˈsloʊli raɪz, ðɛn sɔft ˈmjuːzɪk pleɪz!/
dialogue.zh: 燈光慢慢變亮，再放輕音樂。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the alarm come with sunrise light?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ði əˈlɑrm kʌm wɪð ˈsʌnˌraɪz laɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 鬧鐘能搭配日出燈光嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, schedule the lamp for seven fifteen.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ˈskɛdʒuːl ðə læmp fər ˈsɛvən ˈfɪftin!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，把台燈排在七點十五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set a timer for twelve minutes of tea.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ə ˈtaɪmər fər twɛlv ˈmɪnɪts ʌv ti!/
dialogue.zh: 幫我設個泡茶十二分鐘的計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Captain counts it down from the shelf.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən kaʊnts ɪt daʊn frʌm ðə ʃɛlf!/
dialogue.zh: 管家在架子上幫你倒數。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I ask about the weather?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn aɪ æsk əˈbaʊt ðə ˈwɛðər?/
dialogue.zh: 我能問天氣嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, ask: do I need an umbrella?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, æsk: du a nid æn ʌmˈbrɛlə?/
dialogue.zh: 當然，問：我需要帶傘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Do I need an umbrella today?
dialogue.phonetic: /du a nid æn ʌmˈbrɛlə təˈdeɪ?/
dialogue.zh: 今天需要帶傘嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says bring one after three pm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz brɪŋ wʌn ˈæftər θri ˌpiːˈɛm!/
dialogue.zh: 它說下午三點後記得帶。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add a shopping list to the speaker.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ə ˈʃɑpɪŋ lɪst tə ðə ˈspiːkər!/
dialogue.zh: 把購物清單加到音箱上。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say: add milk to my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ: æd mɪlk tə maɪ lɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 說：把牛奶加進清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Add milk, eggs, and bread to my list.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd mɪlk, ɛɡz, ænd brɛd tə maɪ lɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 把牛奶、雞蛋和麵包加進清單。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It repeats the list to confirm.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt riˈpits ðə lɪst tə kənˈfɜrm!/
dialogue.zh: 它會複誦清單跟你確認。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Play some calm piano music, please.
dialogue.phonetic: /pleɪ sʌm kɑm piˈænoʊ ˈmjuːzɪk, pliz!/
dialogue.zh: 請播放平靜的鋼琴曲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The volume follows your evening setting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈvɑljum ˈfɑloʊz jɔr ˈivnɪŋ ˈsɛtɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 音量會用你晚上的設定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A little louder, oh, too loud now!
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈlɪtəl ˈlaʊdər, oʊ, tu laʊd naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 再大聲一點……噢，太大了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say: turn it down to forty percent.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ: tɜrn ɪt daʊn tə ˈfɔrti pərˈsɛnt!/
dialogue.zh: 說：音量調到百分之四十。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, what time is it?
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, wɑt taɪm ɪz ɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 管家，現在幾點了？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It answers fast, but your watch is quicker.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈænsərz fæst, bʌt jɔr wɑtʃ ɪz ˈkwɪkər./
dialogue.zh: 它會答，不過你的手錶更快。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Set five alarms for my busy week.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt faɪv əˈlɑrmz fər maɪ ˈbɪzi wik!/
dialogue.zh: 為忙碌的一週設五個鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Name each one, like gym or early train.
dialogue.phonetic: /neɪm itʃ wʌn, laɪk dʒɪm ɔr ˈɜrli treɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 每個都命名，比如健身或早班車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cancel the gym alarm for tomorrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkænsəl ðə dʒɪm əˈlɑrm fər təˈmɑroʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 取消明天的健身鬧鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Done, sleep in, you earned the rest.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, slip ɪn, ju ɜrnd ðə rɛst!/
dialogue.zh: 好了，賴床吧，你值得休息。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I tell two things at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn a tɛl tu θɪŋz æt wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 我能一次說兩件事嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, say lights off and lock the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, seɪ laɪts ɔf ænd lɑk ðə dɔr!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，說關燈的並鎖門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hold on, do we own a smart lock?
dialogue.phonetic: /hoʊld ɑn, du wi oʊn ə smɑrt lɑk?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們家有智能鎖嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, we set it up last weekend.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, wi sɛt ɪt ʌp læst ˈwikˌɛnd./
dialogue.zh: 有呀，上週末就裝好了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night mode should run every night.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt moʊd ʃʊd rʌn ˈɛvri naɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 晚安模式每晚都要執行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: At ten: lights low, door locked, voice quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt tɛn: laɪts loʊ, dɔr lɑkt, vɔɪs ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 十點：燈調暗、門上鎖、聲音變小。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Say good night, and watch it happen.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ ɡʊd naɪt, ænd wɑtʃ ɪt ˈhæpən!/
dialogue.zh: 說晚安，然後看著一切發生。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The whole house whispers back: sleep well.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə hoʊl haʊs ˈwɪspərz bæk: slip wɛl!/
dialogue.zh: 整個房子輕聲回應：晚安好夢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did the doors really lock by themselves?
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ðə dɔrz ˈrɪəli lɑk baɪ ðɛmˈsɛlvz?/
dialogue.zh: 門真的自己鎖上了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app shows a green locked icon.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp ʃoʊz ə ɡrin lɑkt ˈaɪkɑn!/
dialogue.zh: App顯示綠色的上鎖圖標。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good morning mode needs a gentle start.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ˈmɔrnɪŋ moʊd nidz ə ˈdʒɛntəl stɑrt./
dialogue.zh: 早安模式要有個溫柔的開始。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Add the coffee maker to that routine too.
dialogue.phonetic: /æd ðə ˈkɔfi ˈmeɪkər tə ðæt ruˈtin tu!/
dialogue.zh: 把咖啡機也加進那個排程。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the plug switch the coffee machine?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə plʌɡ swɪtʃ ðə ˈkɔfi məˈʃin?/
dialogue.zh: 智能插座能控制咖啡機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, old machines join the smart home.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, oʊld məˈʃinz dʒɔɪn ðə smɑrt hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，舊電器也能加入智能家居。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I love waking up to fresh coffee.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ lʌv ˈweɪkɪŋ ʌp tə frɛʃ ˈkɔfi!/
dialogue.zh: 我愛上一股咖啡香的早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set it for seven, but no Sundays.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt ɪt fər ˈsɛvən, bʌt noʊ ˈsʌndeɪz!/
dialogue.zh: 設在七點，但週日不要。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: When we leave, one phrase ends everything.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛn wi liv, wʌn freɪz ɛndz ˈɛvriθɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 出門時，一句話就能收尾一切。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say: I am leaving, and it checks each room.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ: aɪ æm ˈlivɪŋ, ænd ɪt tʃɛks itʃ rum!/
dialogue.zh: 說：我出門了，它就檢查每個房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I am leaving! It turned off the fan.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ æm ˈlivɪŋ! ɪt tɜrnd ɔf ðə fæn!/
dialogue.zh: 我出門了！它把風扇關掉了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart homes never argue about bills.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt hoʊmz ˈnɛvər ˈæɡjʊr əˈbaʊt bɪlz!/
dialogue.zh: 智能家居從不為電費跟你爭論。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can guests use the speaker too?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ɡɛsts juz ðə ˈspiːkər tu?/
dialogue.zh: 客人也能用音箱嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, but turn on guest mode first.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, bʌt tɜrn ɑn ɡɛst moʊd fɜrst!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但要先開訪客模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: What does guest mode actually change?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɑt dʌz ɡɛst moʊd ˈæktʃuəli tʃeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 訪客模式到底改變了什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It hides your lists, alarms, and private rooms.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt haɪdz jɔr lɪsts, əˈlɑrmz, ænd ˈpraɪvət rumz!/
dialogue.zh: 它隱藏你的清單、鬧鐘和私人房間。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My cousin only wanted the weather.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ ˈkʌzən ˈoʊnli ˈwɑntɪd ðə ˈwɛðər!/
dialogue.zh: 我表哥只想查個天氣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It kept the rest of your life private.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt kɛpt ðə rɛst ʌv jɔr laɪf ˈpraɪvət./
dialogue.zh: 它讓你其他的生活保持隱私。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Cooking mode should light the whole counter.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkʊkɪŋ moʊd ʃʊd laɪt ðə hoʊl ˈkaʊntər!/
dialogue.zh: 烹飪模式要照亮整個流理台。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And play my favorite cooking playlist.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd pleɪ maɪ ˈfeɪvərɪt ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈpleɪˌlɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 還要播放我最愛的烹飪歌單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, set a cooking timer for pasta.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, sɛt ə ˈkʊkɪŋ ˈtaɪmər fər ˈpɑstə!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，設個煮意麵的計時。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It pings the moment the pasta is done.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt pɪŋz ðə ˈmoʊmənt ðə ˈpɑstə ɪz dʌn./
dialogue.zh: 意麵一好它就會嗶一聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: My hands are full, the timer helped.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ hændz ɑr fʊl, ðə ˈtaɪmər hɛlpt!/
dialogue.zh: 我滿手東西，計時器幫了大忙。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Voice control shines most in the kitchen.
dialogue.phonetic: /vɔɪs kənˈtroʊl ʃaɪnz moʊst ɪn ðə ˈkɪtʃɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 語音控制在廚房最加分。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I tell it to shush politely?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn a tɛl ɪt tə ʃʊʃ pəˈlaɪtli?/
dialogue.zh: 我能禮貌地叫它安靜嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Say stop, and the speaker obeys at once.
dialogue.phonetic: /seɪ stɑp, ænd ðə ˈspiːkər oʊˈbeɪz æt wʌns!/
dialogue.zh: 說停下，它立刻聽話。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The bedroom is still too bright for sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈbɛdˌrum ɪz stɪl tu braɪt fər slip!/
dialogue.zh: 臥室對睡覺來說還是太亮。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask for ten percent, then close your eyes.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk fər tɛn pərˈsɛnt, ðɛn kloʊz jɔr aɪz!/
dialogue.zh: 說要一成亮度，然後閉上眼。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Whisper mode makes the answer very quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɪspər moʊd meɪks ðə ˈænsər ˈvɛri ˈkwaɪət!/
dialogue.zh: 耳語模式讓回應超級輕聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect when the house needs some quiet.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt wɛn ðə haʊs nidz sʌm ˈkwaɪət./
dialogue.zh: 房子想安靜時剛好有用。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Reading light, ten minutes before bed.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈridɪŋ laɪt, tɛn ˈmɪnɪts bɪˈfɔr bɛd!/
dialogue.zh: 閱讀燈，睡前十分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lamp obeys and warms its color.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə læmp oʊˈbeɪz ænd wɔrmz ɪts ˈkʌlər!/
dialogue.zh: 台燈照做，顏色也變暖了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the speaker hear different voices?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈspiːkər hir ˈdɪfərənt ˈvɔɪsɪz?/
dialogue.zh: 音箱聽得出不一樣的聲音嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it can learn each family member.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt kæn lɜrn itʃ ˈfæməli ˈmɛmbər!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，它能學習每位家人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It heard my son ask for dessert.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt hɜrd maɪ sʌn æsk fər dɪˈzɜrt./
dialogue.zh: 它聽出是我兒子在要甜點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Voice profiles keep everyone honest.
dialogue.phonetic: /vɔɪs ˈproʊˌfaɪlz kip ˈɛvriˌwʌn ˈɑnɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 聲紋檔案讓每個人都無法耍賴。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can kids use the voice commands alone?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn kɪdz juz ðə vɔɪs kəˈmændz əˈloʊn?/
dialogue.zh: 小孩能自己用語音指令嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Sure, but the lock needs your approval.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊr, bʌt ðə lɑk nidz jɔr əˈpruvəl!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，但開門要經你同意。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Send the lights to evening, slowly.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛnd ðə laɪts tə ˈivnɪŋ, ˈsloʊli!/
dialogue.zh: 讓燈光慢慢進入傍晚模式。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The room melts into a soft amber.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rum mɛlts ˈɪntu ə sɔft æmˈbɜr!/
dialogue.zh: 房間融進一片柔和的琥珀色。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, fill the house with rain sounds.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, fɪl ðə haʊs wɪð reɪn saʊndz!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，讓屋子充滿雨聲。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tonight the house feels like a cabin.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈnaɪt ðə haʊs filz laɪk ə ˈkæbɪn!/
dialogue.zh: 今晚家裡像山間小屋。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Every command now feels like a habit.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri kəˈmænd naʊ filz laɪk ə ˈhæbɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 每條指令現在都像一種習慣。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Soon you will forget the old switches.
dialogue.phonetic: /sun ju wɪl fərˈɡɛt ði oʊld ˈswɪtʃəz!/
dialogue.zh: 很快你就會忘了舊開關。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: But the lights still work by hand.
dialogue.phonetic: /bʌt ðə laɪts stɪl wɜrk baɪ hænd!/
dialogue.zh: 不過燈還是能用手開。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, old habits stay as a backup.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd, oʊld ˈhæbɪts steɪ æz ə ˈbækˌʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 很好，舊習慣就當備用方案。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Last thing: name every scene clearly.
dialogue.phonetic: /læst θɪŋ: neɪm ˈɛvri sin ˈklɪrli!/
dialogue.zh: 最後一件事：場景名字要清楚。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Otherwise you just shout into the dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərwaɪz ju dʒʌst ʃaʊt ˈɪntu ðə dɑrk!/
dialogue.zh: 否則你只能對著空氣亂喊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: This morning, not one light answered me.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɪs ˈmɔrnɪŋ, nɑt wʌn laɪt ˈænsərd mi./
dialogue.zh: 今天早上，沒一盞燈理我。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The lights ignored every single command.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə laɪts ɪɡˈnɔrzd ˈɛvri ˈsɪŋɡəl kəˈmænd!/
dialogue.zh: 燈完全不理任何指令。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Is the internet down again, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪz ði ˈɪntərˌnɛt daʊn əˈɡɛn, ðɛn?/
dialogue.zh: 那網路是又斷線了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: My phone shows full bars, but no data.
dialogue.phonetic: /maɪ foʊn ʃoʊz fʊl bɑrz, bʌt noʊ ˈdeɪtə!/
dialogue.zh: 手機滿格卻沒有資料流量。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Then the router probably froze again.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ðə ˈraʊtər ˈprɑbəbli froʊz əˈɡɛn!/
dialogue.zh: 那大概是路由器又當機了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Unplug it, count ten, plug it back.
dialogue.phonetic: /ʌnˈplʌɡ ɪt, kaʊnt tɛn, plʌɡ ɪt bæk!/
dialogue.zh: 拔掉電源，數到十，再插回去。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: See? All the router lights are dancing.
dialogue.phonetic: /si? ɔl ðə ˈraʊtər laɪts ɑr ˈdænsɪŋ./
dialogue.zh: 你看，路由器的燈全在閃。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That means it is rebooting right now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt minz ɪt ɪz ˌribəˈuɪŋ raɪt naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 那表示它正在重啟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: How long should we wait this time?
dialogue.phonetic: /haʊ lɔŋ ʃʊd wi weɪt ðɪs taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 這次我們要等多久？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give it two patient minutes, no more.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ɪt tu ˈpeɪʃənt ˈmɪnɪts, noʊ mɔr!/
dialogue.zh: 給它兩分鐘的耐心，就夠了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Still nothing, even after two reboots.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɪl ˈnʌθɪŋ, ˈivən ˈæftər tu rɪˈbuts./
dialogue.zh: 重啟兩次了，還是沒回應。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Wait, did our wifi password change?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt, dɪd ˈaʊər ˈwaɪfaɪ ˈpæswɜrd tʃeɪndʒ?/
dialogue.zh: 等等，我們的無線密碼改過嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, my brother changed it last week.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ, maɪ ˈbrʌðər tʃeɪndʒd ɪt læst wik./
dialogue.zh: 噢不，我弟弟上週改過了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: He never tells us, that is so him.
dialogue.phonetic: /hi ˈnɛvər tɛlz ʌs, ðæt ɪz soʊ hɪm./
dialogue.zh: 他從不說，真不愧是他。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: So every device needs the new password.
dialogue.phonetic: /soʊ ˈɛvri dɪˈvaɪs nidz ðə nju ˈpæswɜrd!/
dialogue.zh: 所以每個裝置都要重新輸密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Annoying, but the app fixes it fast.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈnɔɪɪŋ, bʌt ði æp ˈfɪksɪz ɪt fæst!/
dialogue.zh: 很煩，但App能快速解決。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do I re-enter the network details?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du a ˌriˈɛntər ðə ˈnɛtˌwɜrk dɪˈteɪlz?/
dialogue.zh: 在哪裡重新輸入網絡資訊？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Settings, then home network, then update.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛtɪŋz, ðɛn hoʊm ˈnɛtˌwɜrk, ðɛn ʌpˈdeɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 設置、家庭網絡、然後更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One bulb is still offline in the list.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn bʌlb ɪz stɪl ˌɔfˈlaɪn ɪn ðə lɪst!/
dialogue.zh: 清單裡還有一個燈泡離線。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the Star bulb in the hallway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə stɑr bʌlb ɪn ðə ˈhɔlˌweɪ!/
dialogue.zh: 就是走廊的那個小星星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That hall is deep inside the apartment.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt hɔl ɪz dip ɪnˈsaɪd ði əˈpɑrtmənt./
dialogue.zh: 那條走廊在屋子最深處。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Thick walls eat the signal for breakfast.
dialogue.phonetic: /θɪk wɔlz it ðə ˈsɪɡnəl fər ˈbrɛkfəst!/
dialogue.zh: 厚牆最會吃掉訊號了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Maybe we need a signal extender.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmeɪbi wi nid ə ˈsɪɡnəl ɪkˈstɛndər!/
dialogue.zh: 也許我們需要訊號延伸器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A small plug-in one costs very little.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə smɔl plʌɡ-ɪn wʌn kɔsts ˈvɛri ˈlɪtəl!/
dialogue.zh: 小小的插電款花不了多少錢。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The speaker finally spoke again!
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈspiːkər ˈfaɪnəli spoʊk əˈɡɛn!/
dialogue.zh: 音箱終於又開口了！

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It says: wifi reconnected, all systems ready.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛz: ˈwaɪfaɪ rɪkəˈnɛktɪd, ɔl ˈsɪstəmz ˈrɛdi!/
dialogue.zh: 它說：網絡已重連，一切就緒。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's test the good night mode once more.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts tɛst ðə ɡʊd naɪt moʊd wʌns mɔr!/
dialogue.zh: 再測一次晚安模式吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Every light obeyed, even stubborn Star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvri laɪt oʊˈbeɪd, ˈivən ˈstʌbərn stɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 每盞燈都聽話了，連固執的小星星也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Why did the speaker light up at midnight?
dialogue.phonetic: /waɪ dɪd ðə ˈspiːkər laɪt ʌp æt ˈmɪdˌnaɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 為什麼音箱半夜會亮起來？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The cat walked past the motion sensor.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə kæt wɔkt pæst ðə ˈmoʊʃən ˈsɛnsər!/
dialogue.zh: 是貓經過動作感應器。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A camera alert woke us both up.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈkæmərə əˈlɜrt woʊk ʌs boʊθ ʌp!/
dialogue.zh: 一個攝影機提醒把我們倆都吵醒了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Set pet mode so it ignores small movers.
dialogue.phonetic: /sɛt pɛt moʊd soʊ ɪt ˌɪɡˈnɔrz smɔl ˈmuvərz!/
dialogue.zh: 設成寵物模式，讓它忽略小小的移動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does pet mode still catch real intruders?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz pɛt moʊd stɪl kætʃ ril ˈɪnˌtruːdərz?/
dialogue.zh: 寵物模式還抓得到真正的小偷嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, it only skips things under one foot.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, ɪt ˈoʊnli skɪps θɪŋz ˈʌndər wʌn fʊt!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，它只會跳過矮小的移動物。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That solves our midnight mystery, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt sɑlvz ˈaʊər ˈmɪdˌnaɪt ˈmɪstəri, ðɛn!/
dialogue.zh: 那我們的半夜謎團就解決了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Poor Miss Cat, now officially unemployed.
dialogue.phonetic: /pʊr mɪs kæt, naʊ əˈfɪʃəli ˌʌnəmˈplɔɪd./
dialogue.zh: 可憐的貓小姐，從此正式失業。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can the microphone listen all the time?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn ðə ˈmaɪkrəˌfoʊn ˈlɪsən ɔl ðə taɪm?/
dialogue.zh: 麥克風會一直在聽嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only for the wake word, then it records.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli fər ðə weɪk wɜrd, ðɛn ɪt riˈkɔrdz!/
dialogue.zh: 只聽喚醒詞，聽到後才錄音。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: I still do not love that idea.
dialogue.phonetic: /aɪ stɪl du nɑt lʌv ðæt aɪˈdiə!/
dialogue.zh: 我還是不太喜歡這一點。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then press the button that cuts the mic.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn prɛs ðə ˈbʌtən ðæt kʌts ðə mɪk!/
dialogue.zh: 那就按一下切斷麥克風的按鈕。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A red bar now covers the light ring.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə rɛd bɑr naʊ ˈkʌvərz ðə laɪt rɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 一道紅槓現在蓋住了燈圈。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Red means the microphone is fully off.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɛd minz ðə ˈmaɪkrəˌfoʊn ɪz ˈfʊli ɔf!/
dialogue.zh: 紅色代表麥克風完全關閉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It feels strange, this quiet house.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt filz streɪndʒ, ðɪs ˈkwaɪət haʊs!/
dialogue.zh: 這安靜的房子感覺有點怪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Press it again whenever you feel safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /prɛs ɪt əˈɡɛn wɛnˈɛvər ju fil seɪf!/
dialogue.zh: 覺得安心時再按開就好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Where do the voice recordings go?
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛr du ðə vɔɪs riˈkɔrdɪŋz ɡoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 語音錄音會被送到哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The app keeps them in one history page.
dialogue.phonetic: /ði æp kips ðɛm ɪn wʌn ˈhɪstəri peɪʤ!/
dialogue.zh: App把它們放在一頁紀錄裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can I delete them all at once?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn a dɪˈlit ðɛm ɔl æt wʌns?/
dialogue.zh: 我能一次全部刪除嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, tap clear history, just like that.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, tæp klɪr ˈhɪstəri, dʒʌst laɪk ðæt!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，點清除紀錄，就這樣。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Done, the page is blank again.
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌn, ðə peɪdʒ ɪz blæŋk əˈɡɛn./
dialogue.zh: 好了，那一頁又空了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You can also auto-delete every three months.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju kæn ˈɔlsoʊ ˌɔtoʊ-dɪˈlit ˈɛvri θri mʌnθs!/
dialogue.zh: 你也可以設每三個月自動刪除。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Turn that on, I forget everything else.
dialogue.phonetic: /tɜrn ðæt ɑn, a fərˈɡɛt ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɛls!/
dialogue.zh: 開啟吧，其他的事我全都會忘。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The camera settings deserve a look too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə ˈkæmərə ˈsɛtɪŋz dɪˈzɜrv ə lʊk tu!/
dialogue.zh: 攝影機設置也該檢查一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Does the camera record day and night?
dialogue.phonetic: /dʌz ðə ˈkæmərə riˈkɔrd deɪ ænd naɪt?/
dialogue.zh: 攝影機日夜都在錄嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only when motion starts, then it stops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli wɛn ˈmoʊʃən stɑrts, ðɛn ɪt stɑps!/
dialogue.zh: 只在動作開始時錄，然後就停。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Can we block the neighbor's window?
dialogue.phonetic: /kæn wi blɑk ðə ˈneɪbərz ˈwɪndoʊ?/
dialogue.zh: 能把鄰居的窗戶遮起來嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, set a privacy zone in the app.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs, sɛt ə ˈprɪvəsi zoʊn ɪn ði æp!/
dialogue.zh: 可以，在App裡畫一個隱私區域。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: A gray box now hides the neighbor's window.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ɡreɪ bɑks naʊ ˈhaɪdz ðə ˈneɪbərz ˈwɪndoʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 灰框現在遮住了鄰居的窗戶。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Polite cameras know exactly where to stop.
dialogue.phonetic: /pəˈlaɪt ˈkæmərz noʊ ɪɡˈzæktli wɛr tə stɑp!/
dialogue.zh: 有禮貌的攝影機知道該停在哪裡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Should we share the camera with anyone?
dialogue.phonetic: /ʃʊd wi ʃɛr ðə ˈkæmərə wɪð ˈɛniˌwʌn?/
dialogue.zh: 我們要跟誰分享攝影機嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Only your parents, and only for the door.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈoʊnli jɔr ˈpɛrənts, ænd ˈoʊnli fər ðə dɔr!/
dialogue.zh: 只給爸媽，而且只看門口。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: They just want to check on the cat.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ dʒʌst wɑnt tə tʃɛk ɑn ðə kæt./
dialogue.zh: 他們其實只想看看貓咪。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give them a guest account, never the main one.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ðɛm ə ɡɛst əˈkaʊnt, ˈnɛvər ðə meɪn wʌn./
dialogue.zh: 給他們訪客帳號，絕不給主要的。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It sent a code to my phone just now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt sɛnt ə koʊd tə maɪ foʊn dʒʌst naʊ./
dialogue.zh: 它剛剛傳了一組碼到手機。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Type it fast, it dies in one minute.
dialogue.phonetic: /taɪp ɪt fæst, ɪt daɪz ɪn wʌn ˈmɪnɪt./
dialogue.zh: 快輸入，一分鐘就失效。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Smart homes need smart passwords, too.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑrt hoʊmz nid smɑrt ˈpæswɜrdz, tu!/
dialogue.zh: 智能家居也需要聰明的密碼。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ours is a silly sentence with numbers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈaʊərz ɪz ə ˈsɪli ˈsɛntəns wɪð ˈnʌmbərz!/
dialogue.zh: 我們的是一句加數字的怪句子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Never reuse the password from your email.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnɛvər riˈjuz ðə ˈpæswɜrd frʌm jɔr ˈimel!/
dialogue.zh: 千萬別把郵箱密碼重複用。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Agreed, one key per door, says my dad.
dialogue.phonetic: /əˈɡrid, wʌn ki pər dɔr, sɛz maɪ dæd!/
dialogue.zh: 同意，我爸說一把鑰匙開一扇門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh, the app sent a strange update.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ, ði æp sɛnt ə streɪndʒ ˈʌpˌdeɪt./
dialogue.zh: 噢，App推了一個奇怪的更新。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Read the notes before you tap install.
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪd ðə noʊts bɪˈfɔr ju tæp ɪnˈstɔl!/
dialogue.zh: 點安裝前先讀更新說明。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: It only fixes bugs and old timers.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt ˈoʊnli fɪksəz bʌɡz ænd oʊld ˈtaɪmərz!/
dialogue.zh: 它只是修錯誤和舊的定時器。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Then install it, updates keep us safe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðɛn ɪnˈstɔl ɪt, ˈʌpˌdeɪts kip ʌs seɪf!/
dialogue.zh: 那就裝吧，更新能保安全。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Did you see? The floor lamp just flickered.
dialogue.phonetic: /dɪd ju si? ðə flɔr læmp dʒʌst ˈflɪkərd./
dialogue.zh: 你看到了嗎？立燈剛剛閃了一下。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Give the little hub two minutes to reboot.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɪv ðə ˈlɪtəl hʌb tu ˈmɪnɪts tə rɪˈbut./
dialogue.zh: 給那個小中樞兩分鐘重啟。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Everything is back, even the tiny Star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈɛvriθɪŋ ɪz bæk, ˈivən ðə ˈtaɪni stɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 一切都回來了，連小星星也是。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Troubleshooting is just patient waiting.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈtrʌblˌʃutɪŋ ɪz dʒʌst ˈpeɪʃənt ˈweɪtɪŋ!/
dialogue.zh: 除錯其實就是在耐心地等。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Let's write our fixes on the fridge.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɛts raɪt ˈaʊər ˈfɪksəz ɑn ðə frɪdʒ!/
dialogue.zh: 把我們的解決方法寫在冰箱上吧。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Step one: wait two minutes, always.
dialogue.phonetic: /stɛp wʌn: weɪt tu ˈmɪnɪts, ˈɔlweɪz!/
dialogue.zh: 第一步：永遠先等兩分鐘。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Next month we add the smart blinds.
dialogue.phonetic: /nɛkst mʌnθ wi æd ðə smɑrt blaɪndz!/
dialogue.zh: 下個月我們要加裝智能窗簾。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: They will open by themselves at dawn.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðeɪ wɪl ˈoʊpən baɪ ðɛmˈsɛlvz æt dɔn!/
dialogue.zh: 它們會在天剛亮時自己拉開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: And a sensor for the leaking pipe.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ə ˈsɛnsər fər ðə ˈlikɪŋ paɪp!/
dialogue.zh: 還要一個漏水感應器給那根管子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: It texts you before the floor floods.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪt tɛksts ju bɪˈfɔr ðə flɔr flʌdz!/
dialogue.zh: 地板淹水前它會先傳訊給你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Small sensors, big peace of mind.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɔl ˈsɛnsərz, bɪɡ pis ʌv maɪnd!/
dialogue.zh: 小感應器，大安心。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: That is the whole point of this home.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt ɪz ðə hoʊl pɔɪnt ʌv ðɪs hoʊm!/
dialogue.zh: 這就是這個家的意義所在。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One day we may add a robot vacuum.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn deɪ wi meɪ æd ə ˈroʊbɑt ˈvækˌjum!/
dialogue.zh: 有一天我們也許會加台掃地機器人。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ask the cat first, she owns this house.
dialogue.phonetic: /æsk ðə kæt fɜrst, ʃi ˈoʊnz ðɪs haʊs!/
dialogue.zh: 先問貓小姐，她才是這房子的主人。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: New devices join with the same steps.
dialogue.phonetic: /nju dɪˈvaɪsəz dʒɔɪn wɪð ðə seɪm stɛps!/
dialogue.zh: 新裝置用同樣的步驟加入。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Plug, pair, name, place, done, easy.
dialogue.phonetic: /plʌɡ, pɛr, neɪm, pleɪs, dʌn, ˈizi!/
dialogue.zh: 插電、配對、命名、放好，完成，簡單。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Remember when all this felt scary?
dialogue.phonetic: /rɪˈmɛmbər wɛn ɔl ðɪs fɛlt ˈskɛri?/
dialogue.zh: 還記得這一切剛開始很可怕嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now I cannot imagine living without it.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ a kænɑt ɪmˈædʒɪn ˈlɪvɪŋ wɪˈðaʊt ɪt!/
dialogue.zh: 現在我無法想像沒有它的日子。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hear that? The house hums before sleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɪr ðæt? ðə haʊs hʌmz bɪˈfɔr slip./
dialogue.zh: 聽見了嗎？房子睡前輕輕哼著。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Lights low, doors safe, cat asleep.
dialogue.phonetic: /laɪts loʊ, dɔrz seɪf, kæt əˈslip!/
dialogue.zh: 燈低低的，門安全的，貓睡著了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Captain, good night to you too.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkæptən, ɡʊd naɪt tə ju tu!/
dialogue.zh: 管家，也跟你說晚安。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The ring dims to a gentle star.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə rɪŋ dɪmz tə ə ˈdʒɛntəl stɑr!/
dialogue.zh: 燈圈慢慢暗成一顆溫柔的小星。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: One tap and the whole home rests.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn tæp ænd ðə hoʊl hoʊm rɛsts!/
dialogue.zh: 輕點一下，整個家就休息了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow it will greet us with sunrise.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑroʊ ɪt wɪl ɡriːt ʌs wɪð ˈsʌnˌraɪz!/
dialogue.zh: 明天它會用日出迎接我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Good night to our cozy little castle.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naɪt tə ˈaʊər ˈkoʊzi ˈlɪtəl ˈkæsəl./
dialogue.zh: 晚安，我們的小城堡。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The smart home answers: sleep tight.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə smɑrt hoʊm ˈænsərz: slip taɪt./
dialogue.zh: 智能家居回應：好好睡。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: At last, the speaker ring goes dark.
dialogue.phonetic: /æt læst, ðə ˈspiːkər rɪŋ ɡoʊz dɑrk./
dialogue.zh: 終於，音箱的燈圈暗了下來。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Perfect, the house dreams with us now.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈpɜrfɪkt, ðə haʊs drimz wɪð ʌs naʊ!/
dialogue.zh: 完美，房子現在陪我們一起入夢。
